rationale: ctype.h pulls in gnu/stubs-32.h which requires gcc-multilib. The isolated VM has no default route to apt-install, so multilib is unavailable. The include is DEAD in the eBPF source: no ctype function (isdigit/isalpha/isupper/islower/isspace/tolower/toupper/isalnum/isprint/isxdigit) is referenced in the ebpf/ tree. Removing the include preserves semantics bit-for-bit (dead-code removal, not a functional change).
